name: Almost Heaven Cascade 4-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Indulge in the pinnacle of relaxation with the Almost Heaven Cascade 4-Person Indoor Sauna, available at Select Saunas. Crafted for those who seek the ultimate in wellness, this sauna invites you to experience tranquility in the comfort of your home. Immerse yourself in the soothing warmth of cedar wood and state-of-the-art technology. The Cascade Indoor Sauna offers a luxurious escape for up to four individuals, making it perfect for quality time with friends and family. Its cedar construction not only exudes a delightful fragrance but also ensures long-lasting durability. With the 9 kW Virta heater, this sauna provides an ideal atmosphere for detoxification, improved circulation, and deep relaxation. Elevate your well-being with the Almost Heaven Cascade, available at Select Saunas. Features Tongue-and-groove lumber sections: 1-3/8” finished thickness Pre-assembled wall and roof sections Choose between rustic or clear western red cedar construction Extra height interior for added head space Multi-level benches for height/heat variation Wall-to-wall floor sections built of 1×2” slatted rustic or clear western cedar lumber Tempered glass door with long stainless handle on the outside, wooden on the inside Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Deluxe stainless steel bucket, ladle, and thermometer/hygrometer kit Backlit therapeutic salt backrest with LED lighting, 110V plug-in 2 full-length benches, multi-level seating Vertical slat 2×4” benches built of rustic or clear western cedar timbers Stone accent wall behind the heater to radiate heat Standard 9kW Virta deluxe sauna heater by Harvia, Finland for maximum power and fast heat-up time Digital heater control; can be mounted on the interior or exterior of the sauna Hand-crafted construction Indoor usage Easy assembly for 2 people Manufactured in the USA Specifications Holds up to four people 9kW Virta deluxe heater with Xenio digital control center; interior or exterior mount Heater electrical: 220V, 40-amp service for heater; 8/3 hardwire connect LED light electrical: 110V plug-in Exterior dimensions: 71”W x 71”D x 84.5”H Interior dimensions: 66”W x 66”D x 80.5”H Lower bench size dimensions: 66”L x 14”W x 22”H Upper bench size dimensions: 66”L x 22”W x 36”H Door size: 64”H x 24”W Window size: 64”H x 25”H (x2) Shipping dimensions: 74”L x 40”W x 49”H Shipping weight: 925 lbs Assembled weight: 800 lbs Assembly Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Useful Link Cascade Installation & Owner's Manual Videos
